Java is a computer programming language that is useful for various applications such as back-end development, android development, desktop computing, games, and numerical computing. It is a class-based, object-oriented, and high-level programming language designed to enable the "write once, run anywhere" (WORA) feature. Java is a general-purpose programming language that allows programmers to write code that is universally compatible and can be executed on multiple platforms without requiring any recompilation. 

Some of its key characteristics include:
* Object-oriented
* Platform independence
* Security
* Multithreaded
* Use of Java Virtual Machine (JVM) and bytecode

It was developed by James Gosling in 1995 and has become widely popular due to its performance, platform independence, and security.
